# Generated files

`tree-sitter generate` produces the parser and schema files under `src/`.
They are committed so consumers can build the grammar without a tree-sitter
CLI, but they are **not** edited by hand.

## What is generated vs source

| Path | Origin |
|---|---|
| `src/parser.c` | generated by `tree-sitter generate` |
| `src/grammar.json` | generated — the compiled grammar table |
| `src/node-types.json` | generated — the public node-type schema used by binding generators and editors |
| `src/scanner.c` | **source**, kept by hand |
| `src/tree_sitter/` | generated — the runtime headers (`parser.h`, …) |

`scanner.c` is the only hand-written file that ends up in the build; the
rest of `src/` is reproducible from `grammar.js` plus `tree-sitter.json`.

## The sync contract

`tree-sitter generate` is the **only** way parser.c changes. The workflow
is always:

1. edit `grammar.js` (or `scanner.c`),
2. run `tree-sitter generate`,
3. run `tree-sitter test` and review the corpus diff.

The spec and this grammar mirror each other one-to-one
(docs/grammar.md §8); the "sync-by-hand" risk of the DSL's *other* parser
(`ulb-lang`, a hand-written descent parser) is tracked in
`Uliab/docs/architecture.md` §11. This repo's contribution to that
contract is: every non-terminal in the EBNF exists in `grammar.js`, and
every corpus case exists in both.

## Config (`tree-sitter.json`)

```json
{
  "grammars": [{ "name": "ulb", "scope": "source.ulb",
                 "file-types": ["ulb"], "highlights": …, "folds": …, "indents": … }],
  "metadata": { "version": "0.1.0", "license": "GPL-3.0", "authors": […] },
  "bindings": { "c": true, "go": false, "node": true,
                "python": false, "rust": true, "swift": false },
  "generate": { "abi": 15 }
}
```

Notes:

- `metadata.version` and `metadata.license` are kept in sync with
  `package.json` (`0.1.0`, `GPL-3.0`). The license was fixed from `MIT` to
  `GPL-3.0` when the repository was relicensed; `package-lock.json`'s root
  version was fixed from `1.0.0` to `0.1.0` in the same pass.
- `bindings.c/node/rust` are enabled; `go/python/swift` are off.
- `generate.abi` pins the tree-sitter ABI the parser targets.
